subject.title: Doctor warns about NVM node instead of Homebrew/system node, but cannot be fixed

question: Should OpenClaw support an explicit daemon runtime pin or warning acknowledgement for version-manager Node users, or keep system Node as the only supported warning-clearing path?
rationale: The remaining work changes public daemon install semantics and possibly persisted service environment or warning policy, which the code cannot choose safely without maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Sponsor Explicit Runtime Pin
options.body: Accept a public daemon runtime-path contract, refresh the open implementation candidate, and require live launchd/systemd/schtasks proof before merge.

options.title: Keep System Node As Policy
options.body: Declare version-manager daemon warnings intentional and document supported system Node as the clearing path, closing or narrowing runtime-pin work accordingly.

options.title: Add Acknowledgement Only
options.body: Allow users to acknowledge intentional version-manager usage while keeping the audit visible, but only if maintainers accept the reduced warning pressure.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Explicit Runtime Pin
recommendation.body: Accept a public daemon runtime-path contract, refresh the open implementation candidate, and require live launchd/systemd/schtasks proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The daemon runtime best-practice audit and shared install-plan scaffolding trace most directly to this history, and the choice affects core gateway setup policy.
